name: demolition-play
note: A person's first level: Play on the title, a pad joins, Start, the first structure chosen with South, the launcher turned on the d-pad, raised, the power set on a shoulder and fired. The shot's flight, every block it breaks and the whole collapse (game.hash: the world's hash of every moved body and event) must be the same bits on every host and on GL and WebGPU. The control never fires.
